subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should the Trim OS packaged Gateway auth/config regeneration be handled as an OpenClaw core Gateway repair, a package-owner follow-up, or kept open until redacted protocol proof identifies the failing frame?
rationale: The remaining remedies could affect Gateway pairing, shared auth, and local bypass behavior, while the package process that reportedly rewrites config is not present in this repository.

options.title: Collect proof before auth changes
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If logs show an OpenClaw client speaking the wrong protocol or opaque diagnostics, improve the Gateway/CLI diagnostic path without loosening pairing.

options.title: Route package ownership
options.body: If only `trim.openclaw` regenerates config outside this tree, keep core auth behavior unchanged and route config-management behavior to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before auth changes
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest observed history across Gateway protocol compatibility, device pairing, and WebSocket auth logging.
